chunks: They and their wives will be in the shade, reclining on couches.
ai.seo_question: How are the righteous described as resting in Paradise in Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Yaseen is often interpreted to highlight the spiritual and physical purity of the spouses, emphasizing that the companionship in Paradise is not merely physical but rooted in mutual spiritual elevation and divine grace. The imagery of reclining on couches (al-ara'ik) signifies a state of dignified rest and leisure, free from the toil of worldly life, reflecting the Shia understanding of Paradise as a realm of perfected human existence.
